definitions.explanation: Inflammation of the bronchial tubes (airways leading to the lungs), causing coughing, mucus production, and difficulty breathing.

examples.japanese: {気管支炎|きかんしえん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こじらせて→こじらせる：22115_kojiraseru⟧{気管支炎|きかんしえん}になってしまった。
examples.english: My cold got worse and turned into bronchitis.

examples.japanese: ⟦{慢性|まんせい}→慢性：09014_mansei⟧{気管支炎|きかんしえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冬場|ふゆば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}→悪化：11077_akka⟧しやすい。
examples.english: Patients with chronic bronchitis tend to have worsening symptoms in winter.

notes:
A compound of {気管支|きかんし} (bronchial tubes) and {炎|えん} (inflammation). The {炎|えん} suffix is used for many inflammatory conditions: ⟦{肺炎|はいえん}→肺炎：08443_haien⟧ (pneumonia), {胃腸炎|いちょうえん} (gastroenteritis), ⟦{関節炎|かんせつえん}→関節炎：08445_kansetsuen⟧ (arthritis), etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{急性|きゅうせい}→急性：09015_kyuusei⟧{気管支炎|きかんしえん} — acute bronchitis
- ⟦{慢性|まんせい}→慢性：09014_mansei⟧{気管支炎|きかんしえん} — chronic bronchitis
- {気管支炎|きかんしえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧ — to come down with bronchitis
- {気管支炎|きかんしえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧ — treatment for bronchitis

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{肺炎|はいえん}→肺炎：08443_haien⟧ — pneumonia (more severe; infection of the lung tissue itself)
- ⟦{喘息|ぜんそく}→喘息：08444_zensoku⟧ — asthma (chronic condition with airway constriction, not the same as bronchitis)
- ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧ — common cold (milder; bronchitis can develop from an untreated cold)
